messages:
Leah (DevEx): Heads-up: minimal monorepo example fails only when run with Vercel Edge and the SDK is a workspace symlink. Error from the dev build: "Package subpath './edge' is not defined by \"exports\" in /workspace/packages/sdk-js/package.json".

Leah (DevEx): Short repro:
1) pnpm i at repo root (pnpm workspace)
2) cd examples/edge-demo && pnpm dev (vercel dev)
3) import { RedwoodClient } from 'sdk-js'
4) build step errors in esbuild/rollup during Vercel dev server compile

Leah (DevEx): Current package.json in packages/sdk-js has basic exports only for main entry (no browser/edge subpath) and "types" is inside dist but TS can't find it when hoisted. Workaround: npm pack -> install tarball fixes it.

Ravi: Can you paste the exact bundler output? is this a resolver error or actual runtime failure?

Leah (DevEx): Build-time resolver error. Snippet:```
Error: Package subpath './edge' is not defined by "exports" in /workspace/packages/sdk-js/package.json
    at Resolver.resolvePackageTarget (/snapshot/rollup/node_modules/resolve/lib/async.js:...)
```

Jordan: Two things to do: add an explicit ./edge export that points at a small ESM bundle for edge, and ensure the package root has a "types" field so TS resolves declarations when hoisted. Also add a "module"/"browser" field to guide bundlers.

Jordan: Example minimal fix suggestion for package.json:```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "module": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "browser": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

Leah (DevEx): Another problem surfaced: auth refresh + automatic fetch retries on Edge caused a refresh-thundering effect. The edge runtime (and some CDNs/proxies) will re-try requests; our client starts refresh on 401 but concurrent retries cause multiple refreshes and a loop. Logs:```
[edge] -> POST /predict => 401
[edge] refreshToken() start (req A)
[edge] retry kicks in -> req B -> also 401 -> triggers refreshToken() (req B)
[edge] refreshToken() finishes (req A) but B still uses stale token -> 401 again
```

Ravi: We should implement a single-flight refresh (promise in-flight share) and ensure retries reuse whatever token state is later. Also consider aborting automatic retries while a refresh is in flight or tagging retry attempts to not trigger refresh.

Leah (DevEx): For immediate onboarding/dev DX, add a short troubleshooting note in docs: pnpm workspace symlink + bundlers (esbuild/rollup) can fail on subpath exports. Recommend either: (a) npm pack install, (b) use a tiny shim package inside examples that re-exports built ESM file, or (c) patch package.json local to include ./edge export.

Jordan: I'll open a PR to add ./edge export + types/top-level fields. Ravi, can you take the single-flight token refresh + tests covering fetch retry behavior (simulate double retry + ensure only one refresh runs)?

Ravi: Yep, will add a simple in-memory lock and a test that mocks fetch retries + verifies only one refresh call occurs. Also add a short integration to ensure AbortSignal forwarding plays nicely with edge runtimes.

Build Bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/427 and branch fix/exports-edge-427

Leah (DevEx): Uploaded a tiny repro to the issue (examples/edge-demo) and tagged as blocker for onboarding docs. I'll update onboarding checklist once PRs merge. Thanks folks :pray:

Rethink CI: Linked issue 427 to project "devex" and added labels: "edge-runtime", "pnpm-workspaces", "auth" :rocket:
